technical.summary: Oversold bounce signals (RSI, Stoch, StochRSI cross) conflict with strong downtrend structure (price below all MAs, MACD bearish, Ichimoku below cloud); ADX strength confirms trend but direction is down—high risk of false reversal without confirmation of uptrend structure.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 47 days present material risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (25/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is neutral with only minor trades and no conviction from senior members; news data unavailable to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (291.5) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational industrials, and earnings in 47 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Oversold RSI/StochRSI cross-up with ADX strength and Supertrend flip provide tactical bounce signals in extreme fear environment (VIX crisis), offering contrarian entry near support at 86.33.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages with bearish MACD, negative CMF, and Ichimoku below cloud confirm structural downtrend; macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, strong dollar, earnings risk in 47 days) and zero fundamental/smart money support make bounce high-risk false reversal.

decision.entry_rationale: Oversold bounce signals (RSI cross, Supertrend flip) offer tactical entry at support in extreme fear environment; however, structural downtrend (price below all MAs, bearish MACD, Ichimoku below cloud) and severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar) create unacceptable risk-reward for swing trade.
decision.primary_risk: False reversal bounce into continued downtrend as macro headwinds persist; earnings event in 47 days adds material gap risk with zero fundamental support.
